Container.Name: MetaFusion
Container.Overview: Metadata and artwork generator for selected Plex libraries. MetaFusion enriches Plex data with TMDb and writes Kometa-compatible metadata and assets or places artwork beside Plex media.
Container.Requires: A reachable Plex server, a Plex token, a TMDb API key, exact Plex library names, and writable output paths. Do not override the image entrypoint or Docker user.

Config.Name: Appdata Config Path
Config.Description: Required persistent configuration, cache, logs, and status storage. The container prepares this path for PUID and PGID.

Config.Name: Kometa Output Path
Config.Description: Required when RUN_MODE is kometa. Map the host directory where MetaFusion may write metadata and assets.

Config.Name: Plex Media Path
Config.Description: Optional Plex-mode media mapping. The container paths must match the paths reported by Plex; add or edit mappings when Plex uses paths other than /media.

Config.Name: Output Mode
Config.Description: Required output mode. kometa writes Kometa YAML and assets; plex writes artwork beside media and does not create Kometa YAML.

Config.Name: Plex URL
Config.Description: Required complete Plex server URL, for example http://192.168.1.10:32400.

Config.Name: Plex Token
Config.Description: Required Plex authentication token. It is masked in the Unraid form and redacted from MetaFusion logs.

Config.Name: Plex Libraries
Config.Description: Required comma-separated exact Plex library names.

Config.Name: TMDb API Key
Config.Description: Required TMDb API key. It is masked in the Unraid form and redacted from MetaFusion logs.

Config.Name: Runtime User ID
Config.Description: Unraid nobody user ID. Keep 99 unless your output paths use a different owner.

Config.Name: Runtime Group ID
Config.Description: Unraid users group ID. Keep 100 unless your output paths use a different group.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone used by RUN_TIMES, for example Asia/Singapore.

Config.Name: Kometa Container Path
Config.Description: Container output root used in Kometa mode. Keep aligned with the /kometa path mapping.

Config.Name: Plex Token File
Config.Description: Optional mounted secret-file path. PLEX_TOKEN takes priority when both are set.

Config.Name: TMDb API Key File
Config.Description: Optional mounted secret-file path. TMDB_API_KEY takes priority when both are set.

Config.Name: TMDb Metadata Language
Config.Description: Metadata language and primary artwork language.

Config.Name: TMDb Artwork Fallbacks
Config.Description: Comma-separated artwork-only fallback languages. Metadata text still uses TMDB_LANGUAGE.

Config.Name: TMDb Region
Config.Description: Release and certification region used for metadata.

Config.Name: Run Once on Container Start
Config.Description: Run once instead of remaining in scheduler mode. Normally keep False for an Unraid service.

Config.Name: Enable Scheduler
Config.Description: Keep the container running and execute at RUN_TIMES.

Config.Name: Run When Scheduler Starts
Config.Description: Run one job immediately after scheduler startup, then continue normally.

Config.Name: Scheduled Run Times
Config.Description: Comma-separated daily HH:MM times interpreted using TZ.

Config.Name: Dry Run
Config.Description: Calculate and log without writing generated data or deleting files.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Application logging verbosity.

Config.Name: Generate Basic Metadata
Config.Description: Generate core metadata. Enhanced metadata requires this option.

Config.Name: Generate Enhanced Metadata
Config.Description: Generate extended cast and crew metadata.

Config.Name: Manage Posters
Config.Description: Manage movie and show posters.

Config.Name: Manage Season Posters
Config.Description: Manage season posters, including Specials.

Config.Name: Manage Backgrounds
Config.Description: Manage movie and show background artwork.

Config.Name: Guarded Cleanup
Config.Description: Enable guarded orphan cleanup. Run with DRY_RUN first and verify every library name.

Config.Name: Maximum Concurrency
Config.Description: Maximum media items processed concurrently.

Config.Name: Request Timeout
Config.Description: Total TMDb and image request timeout in seconds.

Config.Name: Connect Timeout
Config.Description: HTTP connection timeout in seconds.

Config.Name: Plex Request Timeout
Config.Description: Timeout for each blocking Plex request in seconds.

Config.Name: Plex Retries
Config.Description: Plex startup connection attempts.

Config.Name: Plex Retry Delay
Config.Description: Base delay between Plex connection retries in seconds.

Config.Name: Shutdown Timeout
Config.Description: Internal graceful shutdown deadline in seconds. Keep below the Docker stop timeout.

Config.Name: Maximum Image Size
Config.Description: Maximum accepted artwork download size in MiB.

Config.Name: Incremental Processing
Config.Description: Skip successfully processed unchanged items.

Config.Name: Full Scan Interval Hours
Config.Description: Maximum interval between complete reconciliation scans.

Config.Name: Default Image Upgrade Days
Config.Description: Minimum age before unchanged artwork is reconsidered. Set 0 to disable timed upgrades.

Config.Name: Movie Image Upgrade Days
Config.Description: Optional movie-specific interval. Blank inherits IMAGE_UPGRADE_DAYS.

Config.Name: Series Image Upgrade Days
Config.Description: Optional series-specific interval. Blank inherits IMAGE_UPGRADE_DAYS.

Config.Name: Season Image Upgrade Days
Config.Description: Optional season-specific interval. Blank inherits IMAGE_UPGRADE_DAYS.

Config.Name: TMDb Cache
Config.Description: Persist successful TMDb JSON responses.

Config.Name: TMDb Cache TTL Hours
Config.Description: TMDb response lifetime in hours.

Config.Name: TMDb Cache Maximum Entries
Config.Description: Maximum persisted TMDb responses.

Config.Name: TMDb Cache Maximum MiB
Config.Description: Optional compressed-payload limit in MiB. Set 0 to disable the byte cap.

Config.Name: Validate Kometa Output
Config.Description: Validate generated Kometa YAML before replacing known-good output.

Config.Name: Output Backup Count
Config.Description: Metadata backups retained per output file.

Config.Name: Allow Ambiguous Editions
Config.Description: Allow unsafe duplicate edition matching. Leave False unless explicitly accepting the risk.

Config.Name: Fail Healthcheck After Job Error
Config.Description: Mark the container unhealthy when the latest job failed.

Config.Name: Health Heartbeat Maximum Age
Config.Description: Maximum scheduler heartbeat age in seconds.

Config.Name: Poster Maximum Width
Config.Description: Preferred maximum poster width.

Config.Name: Poster Maximum Height
Config.Description: Preferred maximum poster height.

Config.Name: Poster Minimum Width
Config.Description: Minimum preferred poster width.

Config.Name: Poster Minimum Height
Config.Description: Minimum preferred poster height.

Config.Name: Poster Preferred Vote
Config.Description: Preferred TMDb poster vote score.

Config.Name: Poster Relaxed Vote
Config.Description: Relaxed fallback poster vote score.

Config.Name: Poster Upgrade Vote Threshold
Config.Description: Vote score used when deciding poster upgrades.

Config.Name: Season Poster Maximum Width
Config.Description: Preferred maximum season-poster width.

Config.Name: Season Poster Maximum Height
Config.Description: Preferred maximum season-poster height.

Config.Name: Season Poster Minimum Width
Config.Description: Minimum preferred season-poster width.

Config.Name: Season Poster Minimum Height
Config.Description: Minimum preferred season-poster height.

Config.Name: Season Poster Preferred Vote
Config.Description: Preferred TMDb season-poster vote score.

Config.Name: Season Poster Relaxed Vote
Config.Description: Relaxed fallback season-poster vote score.

Config.Name: Season Poster Upgrade Vote Threshold
Config.Description: Vote score used when deciding season-poster upgrades.

Config.Name: Background Maximum Width
Config.Description: Preferred maximum background width.

Config.Name: Background Maximum Height
Config.Description: Preferred maximum background height.

Config.Name: Background Minimum Width
Config.Description: Minimum preferred background width.

Config.Name: Background Minimum Height
Config.Description: Minimum preferred background height.

Config.Name: Background Preferred Vote
Config.Description: Preferred TMDb background vote score.

Config.Name: Background Relaxed Vote
Config.Description: Relaxed fallback background vote score.

Config.Name: Background Upgrade Vote Threshold
Config.Description: Vote score used when deciding background upgrades.

Config.Name: Container Config Directory
Config.Description: Container configuration and state directory. Normally leave unchanged.

Config.Name: Runtime Status File
Config.Description: Scheduler status and healthcheck file. Normally leave unchanged.
